title: picea abies var. virgata
intro: Picea abies var. virgata, commonly known as Weeping Norway Spruce, is a coniferous evergreen tree variety native to Europe. It is valued for its unique weeping branches and is used in ornamental landscaping. The essential oil extracted from the needles of Weeping Norway Spruce has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Weeping Norway Spruce include terpenes, such as pinene and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
